project_type: R package sub-package (bucketimpute) inside the earth MARS repo
build_system: R CMD build / R CMD INSTALL / R CMD check; roxygen2 for docs
test_framework: tinytest or plain testthat-style R scripts under tests/; use whatever is lightest (tinytest preferred, base R stopifnot acceptable)
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/earth && R CMD build bucketimpute && R CMD INSTALL bucketimpute
verification_instructions: 1) roxygenise the package to regenerate NAMESPACE and man/*.Rd. 2) R CMD build bucketimpute. 3) R CMD check the resulting tarball with --no-manual (no LaTeX in sandbox). 4) Confirm 0 ERRORs; document WARNINGs/NOTEs. 5) Run package tests. Then run the evaluation scripts as separate timed invocations.
snapshot_or_generated_files: man/*.Rd and NAMESPACE are generated by roxygen2::roxygenise(). Regenerate with Rscript -e 'roxygen2::roxygenise("bucketimpute")'. Do NOT hand-edit generated files.
setup_instructions: R installed via 'sudo dnf install -y R' (R 4.5.3, AL2023). CRAN binaries from PPM: options(repos=c(CRAN='https://p3m.dev/cran/__linux__/rhel9/latest')); set HTTPUserAgent to the RHEL9 UA string; install.packages(c('earth','lars','MASS','kernlab','AppliedPredictiveModeling','Formula','plotmo','plotrix','TeachingDemos','cpp11','caret'), Ncpus=4). All already installed and load OK. packages.posit.co does NOT resolve; use p3m.dev.
environment_constraints: No LaTeX -> use R CMD check --no-manual. /tmp is NOT visible to the bash sandbox for cross-step persistence; write throwaway scripts under the repo dir then delete them, keep them out of git. BIR fits n*p earth models per fit; solubility (p=228) => 2280 earth models each regressing 1 col on 227 others on ~66 rows (p>>rows) => slow/thin. Use hard timeouts, smoke first, per-dataset timed runs. Boston and synthetic_large tractable; spam has 2-value y so quantile bucketing at n>=2 must ERROR (expected, reportable).
contribution_requirements: Work commits onto branch ImputedValuePredictionTest only. Do NOT push, open/modify PRs, or switch branches. Leave working tree clean apart from deliverables; remove build artifacts (tarball, .Rcheck dir).
key_patterns: S3 class 'bir'. Exports fit_bir(), predict.bir(). CRITICAL DEVIATION from spec: use lars (NOT glmnet). Fit lars(affinities,y,type='lasso'); select penalty via cv.lars() choosing the fraction with MINIMUM CV MSE (lars analogue of glmnet lambda.min); store lars fit + chosen s + mode; predict via predict.lars(fit,newx=affinities,s=<chosen>,mode=<chosen>,type='fit'). Document this substitution. Edge cases: min rows per bucket (warn/error when bucket too thin for p predictors), floor residual scale s_{k,j} at small epsilon, ERROR clearly if quantile bucketing does not yield n distinct buckets (n>=2), preserve column names/order so each of p imputation models predicts correct column from correct others.
relevant_files: cv.lars returns $index (fraction grid, mode='fraction') and $cv (CV MSE vector); pick fraction at which.min($cv)
directory_structure: earth repo root has DESCRIPTION/NAMESPACE/R/src/man/tests/inst for the earth package itself. The new bucketimpute package lives in its own self-contained subdir /projects/sandbox/earth/bucketimpute with its own DESCRIPTION/NAMESPACE/R/man/tests. Evaluation scripts + results doc live under the repo (e.g. bucketimpute/inst/eval/ or a top-level eval dir) committed on the branch.
